A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same OPE model-selection work. Their text, equations, figures, table, and appendices support reliable comparison despite substantial reformatting and section relocation.

before.justification: Section 6 and Appendix E report original Hopper-v4 simulations comparing selectors, including coverage, misspecification, feature-variant, and rollout experiments.

after.justification: Section 6 and Appendix E retain the original Hopper-v4 selector comparisons and supplementary experiments.

M1.justification: LSTD-Tournament, its normalization variants, and the regression-based and sign-flip selectors retain their procedures and objectives. The detailed model-based development moves from v1 Section 4 to v2 Appendix B.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same Hopper-v4 gravity and noise grids, target and behavior policies, poor-coverage conditions, and gap, misspecification, and mixed-coverage scenarios. The new pipeline illustration introduces no additional evaluated task.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is retained throughout the main and appendix experiments. In Figure 3, mb_ZDMAK23 and mb_ASM08 become mb_Zitovsky et al. and mb_Antos et al.; these are renamed versions of the same comparators.

E3.justification: Table 1 and Sections 5–6 retain the policy subsets, behavior mixtures, 15/5 candidate-model comparisons, sample-size settings, horizon of 1,024, and 128 rollouts for the main experiments. The appendix rollout experiment also retains its design.

E4.justification: The gap, misspecification, data-coverage, poor-coverage, feature-variant, and small-rollout analyses are retained. Their appendix displays map from v1 Figures 5–10 to v2 Figures 6–11 without additional experimental analyses.

E5.justification: Both versions describe bootstrapped resampling and report mean performance with 95% confidence intervals in Section 5.2. No new seed counts, repeated-run counts, significance tests, or uncertainty-reporting procedures are disclosed.

E6.justification: The matched plots retain their result curves, uncertainty bands, rankings, and overall findings, including all appendix experiments. Figure 1 changes its axis label and plotting geometry without changing the underlying plotted values; Figure 3 changes comparator labels.

T1.justification: Appendix C.5 adds limited mathematical analysis of the singular-value coverage condition: feature scaling changes sigma_min(A), while dependent features can make it zero despite adequate coverage. It also considers an alternative coverage ratio. Existing propositions, theorems, and proofs are retained apart from numbering.

C1.justification: The introduction drops v1's claim that LSTD-Tournament relies on more plausible assumptions than BVFT. The algorithmic contributions, controllable experimental protocol, and rate advantage remain; expressing rates using sample size instead of sample complexity does not strengthen the claim.

C2.justification: New Section 7 substantially discusses how simulator-generated Q-function errors may differ from learned FQE errors, proposes more realistic perturbations, and recommends considering both benchmarking protocols. Appendix C.5 develops coverage-condition limitations and unresolved off-policy questions that v1 addressed only briefly.

D1.justification: New Appendix D.3 discloses CPU simulation and GPU inference costs, nearly one week on a 4090 PC for MF.G, and comparable runtimes for MF.N, MB.G, and MB.N. This adds reproducibility information without establishing a change in experimental settings.

R1.justification: Appendix A substantially expands positioning against adaptive OPE, function-class selection, and Bellman-operator selection, including Su et al., Lee et al., and Miyaguchi. It explains differences in nested classes, Bellman completeness, black-box access, and compatibility with the proposed protocol, beyond ordinary citation additions.

P1.justification: The narrative is substantially reorganized: Section 2 presents model-free selection first, Section 4 becomes an overview with detailed development moved to Appendix B, and related work gains thematic organization. The introduction and problem exposition are revised, and a concluding limitations section is added.

P2.justification: The main text and references change from two columns to one, substantially reflowing and rescaling the displays. v2 adds the pipeline diagram in Figure 5, corrects Figure 1's axis from Noise to Gravity, expands Figure 3's legend names, and relocates retained appendix figures.

improvement.justification: v2 improves transparency through the developed realism and coverage limitations in Section 7 and Appendix C.5, clearer research positioning, the pipeline diagram, and computational-cost disclosure. These address explanatory gaps in v1, while the algorithms, established guarantees, and empirical evidence remain unchanged, supporting a limited overall quality improvement.
